_about: Shared study-corner rules (Task 6): site/src/museum/reconstruction.js validateCorner and tools/content_check.py validate_corner must give the same verdicts. Each case applies 'set' ([path, value]) and 'delete' (path) to a copy of 'base'; 'match' is a substring of the joined errors, null means no errors. 'constants' must equal both implementations' constants.

constants.corner_note: Modern stand-in furniture of the kinds these two photographs show. The designs are not the originals; sizes and positions are estimated.
constants.corner_where_lite: In the 3D museum, this recreated corner stands in the room for this chapter.
